about: Paths the Loop must not plan, test or fix in this repository. 'prefix' is a path prefix, the same rule as a Loop start request's scope.exclude. .gitattributes marks the same paths linguist-vendored. bench/ and .claude/ are not part of a published package; the tree-sitter grammar files under packages/circle-ir/wasm/ ship in circle-ir (copied to dist/wasm at build) as its runtime grammars.

entries.origin: this repository: benchmark scripts and their labelled fixtures (bench/README.md)
entries.licence: n/a (not published; outside every package's files)
entries.notes: Benchmark fixtures and the scripts that produce the resolver's published numbers. Not product code: a chore here would change benchmark inputs, not the engine.

entries.origin: prebuilt tree-sitter grammar binaries, committed as-is; no script in this repository builds them (packages/circle-ir/scripts/copy-wasm.mjs only copies them into dist/wasm)
entries.version: not recorded per file; nearest facts in this repository: tree-sitter-bash 0.25.1, tree-sitter-html 0.23.2, tree-sitter-java 0.23.5, tree-sitter-javascript 0.23.1, tree-sitter-python 0.25.0, tree-sitter-rust 0.24.0, tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2 (typescript and tsx) are the versions in package-lock.json; tree-sitter-c-sharp 0.23.5 per the commit that added the file; tree-sitter-go not found
entries.licence: MIT (package-lock.json for the seven locked packages; npm registry for tree-sitter-go and tree-sitter-c-sharp); shipped in the circle-ir package via dist/wasm
entries.notes: Ten generated grammar binaries (bash, csharp, go, html, java, javascript, python, rust, tsx, typescript), not hand-written source. They are runtime files of circle-ir: replace them with a rebuilt grammar, do not edit them.
